en.headline: Man jailed 54 months for laundering 4.1 million from crypto scheme
en.dek: A 29-year-old local man was convicted in the District Court of two money-laundering counts tied to a virtual-asset scheme that left 78 victims about 28 million out of pocket.
body: A 29-year-old local man was sentenced in the District Court on Friday to 54 months in prison after being convicted of two counts of dealing with property known or believed to represent proceeds of an indictable offence, commonly called money laundering.

Police said they began receiving reports in early 2019 from 78 people who had paid a company for computer equipment and services linked to virtual currency, then received neither the promised returns nor refunds. Combined losses were about 28 million dollars.

Commercial Crime Bureau officers later arrested three men, including the defendant, suspected of using bank accounts to handle about 4.1 million dollars in criminal proceeds. Police said the defendant's accounts showed large, unusual inflows that did not match his reported casual-work income.

Police welcomed the sentence and urged the public not to rent out or sell bank or payment-tool accounts, warning that doing so can amount to money laundering, punishable by a fine of 5 million dollars and 14 years' imprisonment.

zh.headline: 29歲男子洗黑錢罪成判囚54個月 涉款410萬
zh.dek: 區域法院周五裁定一名29歲本地男子兩項處理犯罪得益罪成，判監54個月。案件涉虛擬貨幣相關計劃，78名事主合共損失約2800萬元。
body: 一名29歲本地男子周五在區域法院被裁定兩項俗稱「洗黑錢」的「處理已知道或相信為代表從可公訴罪行的得益的財產」罪罪名成立，判處監禁54個月。
警方表示，2019年初陸續接獲78名事主報案，指他們向一間公司購買與虛擬貨幣相關的電腦設備及服務後，未能取得回報或退款，總損失約2800萬元。
商業罪案調查科其後拘捕包括被告在內的三名男子，懷疑他們利用銀行戶口處理約410萬元犯罪得益。警方指被告戶口在約一年內有大額異常資金流入，與其報稱的散工收入明顯不符。
警方對判決表示歡迎，並呼籲市民切勿租借或賣出個人銀行或支付工具戶口，以免被利用收受騙款。一經定罪，最高可處罰款500萬元及監禁14年。
